items.description: Non-preempting native OuterSpace Agent v1 workloads.

validations.expression: has(object.spec.runtimeClassName) && object.spec.runtimeClassName == 'outerspace-agent-v1' && object.spec.schedulerName == 'default-scheduler' && has(object.spec.nodeSelector) && 'outerspace.sh.node-restriction.kubernetes.io/agent-profile' in object.spec.nodeSelector && object.spec.nodeSelector['outerspace.sh.node-restriction.kubernetes.io/agent-profile'] == 'v1' && (!has(object.spec.nodeName) || object.spec.nodeName == '' || (request.operation == 'UPDATE' && object.spec.nodeName == oldObject.spec.nodeName))
validations.message: OuterSpace Agent v1 requires the approved RuntimeClass and trusted node selection; direct node placement is forbidden.
OuterSpace Agent v1 forbids host and shared process namespaces.
OuterSpace Agent v1 forbids service account tokens and device claims.
OuterSpace Agent v1 forbids priority escalation, preemption, alternate user namespaces and registry credential references.
OuterSpace Agent v1 forbids extra group authority, workload sysctls and unmasked proc mounts.
OuterSpace Agent v1 permits one container and no init or ephemeral containers.
OuterSpace Agent v1 requires UID/GID 65534, RuntimeDefault seccomp and the loaded Agent v1 AppArmor profile.

validations.expression: variables.containers.all(c, has(c.securityContext) && c.securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation == false && c.securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem == true && (!has(c.securityContext.privileged) || !c.securityContext.privileged) && c.securityContext.capabilities.drop == ['ALL'] && (!has(c.securityContext.capabilities.add) || size(c.securityContext.capabilities.add) == 0) && (!has(c.securityContext.runAsUser) || c.securityContext.runAsUser == 65534) && (!has(c.securityContext.runAsGroup) || c.securityContext.runAsGroup == 65534) && (!has(c.securityContext.runAsNonRoot) || c.securityContext.runAsNonRoot) && (!has(c.securityContext.seccompProfile) || c.securityContext.seccompProfile.type == 'RuntimeDefault') && (!has(c.securityContext.appArmorProfile) || (c.securityContext.appArmorProfile.type == 'Localhost' && c.securityContext.appArmorProfile.localhostProfile == 'outerspace-agent-v1')))
validations.message: OuterSpace Agent v1 container security controls cannot be removed or overridden.

validations.expression: has(object.spec.volumes) && size(object.spec.volumes) == 2 && object.spec.volumes.all(v, has(v.emptyDir) && v.emptyDir.medium == 'Memory' && has(dyn(v.emptyDir).sizeLimit) && ((v.name == 'workspace' && quantity(dyn(v.emptyDir).sizeLimit).compareTo(quantity('64Mi')) == 0) || (v.name == 'scratch' && quantity(dyn(v.emptyDir).sizeLimit).compareTo(quantity('16Mi')) == 0)))
validations.message: OuterSpace Agent v1 permits only its bounded per-pod memory workspace and scratch volumes.

validations.expression: variables.containers.all(c, has(c.volumeMounts) && size(c.volumeMounts) == 2 && c.volumeMounts.all(m, ((m.name == 'workspace' && m.mountPath == '/workspace') || (m.name == 'scratch' && m.mountPath == '/scratch')) && (!has(m.subPath) || m.subPath == '') && (!has(m.subPathExpr) || m.subPathExpr == '') && (!has(m.mountPropagation) || m.mountPropagation == 'None') && (!has(m.readOnly) || !m.readOnly)) && (!has(c.volumeDevices) || size(c.volumeDevices) == 0))
validations.message: OuterSpace Agent v1 forbids additional mounts, subpaths, mount propagation and block devices.

validations.expression: variables.containers.all(c, c.image.matches('^[A-Za-z0-9./:_-]+@sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$') && has(c.resources.limits) && has(c.resources.requests) && ['cpu', 'memory', 'ephemeral-storage'].all(k, k in c.resources.limits && k in c.resources.requests && quantity(c.resources.requests[k]).compareTo(quantity('0')) > 0 && quantity(c.resources.limits[k]).compareTo(quantity('0')) > 0) && c.resources.limits.all(k, k in ['cpu', 'memory', 'ephemeral-storage']) && c.resources.requests.all(k, k in ['cpu', 'memory', 'ephemeral-storage']) && quantity(c.resources.limits['cpu']).compareTo(quantity('1')) <= 0 && quantity(c.resources.limits['memory']).compareTo(quantity('256Mi')) <= 0 && quantity(c.resources.limits['ephemeral-storage']).compareTo(quantity('64Mi')) <= 0 && (!has(c.resources.claims) || size(c.resources.claims) == 0))
validations.message: OuterSpace Agent v1 requires immutable image references and bounded CPU, memory and storage; accelerator resources are forbidden.

validations.expression: variables.containers.all(c, (!has(c.ports) || c.ports.all(p, !has(p.hostPort) || p.hostPort == 0)) && (!has(c.envFrom) || size(c.envFrom) == 0) && (!has(c.env) || c.env.all(e, !has(e.valueFrom)))) && (!has(object.metadata.annotations) || object.metadata.annotations.all(k, !k.contains('apparmor') && !k.contains('seccomp')))
validations.message: OuterSpace Agent v1 forbids host ports, injected credentials and legacy security overrides.
